judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Breathless exclamations, the double-dash aside, 'We best go', 'really big bugs' and the clipped key-and-gate instruction all match Nox's plain, slightly goofy campaign voice; the escort-to-a-secret-passage shape and the 'Thank the stars... lad' payoff feel authentic, though 'Chief Engineer' twice is a touch tidy.
